newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac, Juppe gain slightly in poll.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac, Juppe gain slightly in poll.

text.p: The popularity of French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe has increased slightly from near-record lows, according to an opinion poll released on Thursday.

The IPSOS survey for the weekly Le Point said 34 percent of those polled had a good impression of Chirac and 27 percent had a good impression of Juppe, up two and five points respectively from a similar poll last month.

The poll of 965 people was carried out on December 13-14, just after Chirac gave Juppe his full support in a lengthy television interview and ruled out a cabinet reshuffle despite record unemployment and highly unfavourable poll ratings.
